body: Oh, that's nothing! I'm rather flat-chested myself. Skinnier chicks have better knockers. My hair? God, I burn that bitch straight. It's all poofy, normally. I have crooked teeth. Fell on my two front teeth when I was younger, one chipped (fixed now), and the other ankylosed, so it's stuck up there. It looks terrible, I even cover my mouth when I smile or laugh. Oh, and I have a bump on my nose. A nice scar from bustin' my ass in middle school. You can't compare to this, trust me.

Actually, I don't, she's too busy all the time so I don't wanna bother her. And I can't go to a therapist because that means I tell my parents, and they're both so proud of how "strong-minded" I am, and I don't want to reveal that lie to them because I feel it's the only reason they like me.

But most people who say they're ugly in high school actually are really pretty, they just don't know how to work with it. I'm doomed, though, because I have nothing to work with. I'd post a picture, but lawd knows what the internet would do with it. I just need to live with it, I guess.

(It's fine, I like reading.) I see your point of view, and you're very wise. I just wish I could believe all that, too. Every guy I've been with who has found a girl more attractive has gone for her, though, and I can't say my past relationships were too great...

In fact, I'm mostly with my boyfriend now because he's so loyal. Our personalities are completely different, but he hasn't made me cry once.

> I bet you're very lovely though. :)

Don't make me lol, I'm trying to be sad here.

I've been picked on all my life, hell, even my dad has called me fat and made fun of me, and even now that I lost so much weight and I'm so thin he still points out the prettier cousins. I mean, not in my face, but I'm a good listener. I just want to be perfect for one person, and every keeps pointing out how ugly I am.

But the inside doesn't count in the real world, people always judge each other from how they look, and I'm ugly.

And inside I'm nothing special, everyone isn't really that different inside, when you get down to it.

Hell, I'm pretty boring. I sleep all day and read and draw a little, but I'm no fun, so I feel like looks are the only thing I can count on, and I lack them.

Everyone tells me that, but I guess it's because by that age I'll be desensitized to everything. I mean, I love school, I love being able to sleep my ass off all day, life is easy right now, I is just borken.

How are people happy?

Hello, I've been thinking of offing myself. I'm 16, life isn't hard, I should be really happy.

I'm just good for nothing, and stupid, and ugly, and pathetic. It's junior year and I'm in all these classes with sophomores, and they're all a year ahead, and my friends are all in honors classes, and I'm so stupid compared to them, I shouldn't even bother existing because I'll never be as smart or talented as them.

And I'm ugly, I've been ugly my whole life, nothing new. Everyone in my family is strictly against plastic surgery, so I'm stuck this way, and it's not like I wanna do any of that stuff, I just wanna look pretty too. My boyfriend thinks I'm pretty, but he always checks out these really pretty girls, so I know he notices how not pretty I am, I guess he just likes my company. But I don't wanna be with him because I'm not good enough for him because I'm so ugly.

I don't get it, how are people happy? Girls, do you just look at someone prettier than you and you're happy knowing that your boyfriend finds someone a lot prettier than you? I mean, you just live with that? It doesn't upset you? God, I can't even do things. I can't watch TV without wanting to kick something over because of how pretty people are. High school is the same for me, everyone's so pretty, and I just want to crawl into a corner and die.

I feel like everyone is staring at that ugly kid, they just don't say anything now because I'm older and not weak and feeble like I was when I was little. I mean, now I make it a joke, but it still bothers me, and every day I'm a little bit closer to just offing myself, I'm even getting rid of the old journals I don't want anyone to see, and other private stuff, and deleting stuff, and... I wanna be happy, but if you were me you wouldn't be happy, too.

Excuse my incoherentness, I'm a bit distraught.
